card.name: Adjective right after "very"
card.fires_on: The adjective placed right after an intensifier like "very" or "highly", most often "real" or "specific". Also the second "very" in "very, very".

modes.label: Adjective after very
modes.description: An adjective such as real, specific, human or different directly after "very".
modes.example: sex trafficking and human slavery remain a very<< real>> problem

modes.label: Repeated very
modes.description: The second "very" in "very, very" before a size or speed word.
modes.example: descend very,<< very>> slowly over its 60-km

modes.label: After highly
modes.description: A word after "highly", sometimes partway through a longer word.
modes.example: was banned for obscenity in a highly<< public>>ized trial

card.plain: It fires on the word that comes right after "very", as in "a very real problem".
